chunks: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about black dirhams being with a man while he is praying, whether tied or untied, and he said:
"I do not desire that he should pray while these dirhams that have images on them are with him."

Then he عليه السلام said: "People have no alternative but to safeguard their belongings, so if he prays while they are with him, then let them be behind him, and he should not place anything from them between himself and the qiblah."

key_terms.التَّمَاثِيلُ: images or figures depicted on the coins
key_terms.الدَّرَاهِمِ: dirhams, coined money being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.السُّودِ: black, describing the type of dirhams
key_terms.بَضَائِعِهِمْ: their goods or belongings that they must safeguard

ai.seo_question: Can a person perform salat while carrying coins that have images on them?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning praying while carrying dirhams bearing images. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام expresses dislike for praying with such coins, but recognizes practical necessity in safeguarding one's property, instructing that they be kept behind the worshipper and not between him and the qiblah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.783 - Abdul Rahman ibn Al-Hajjaj asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about black dirhams (coins) with images on them being with a man while he prays, whether tied or untied.
Imam (as) said: "I do not desire that he prays while having these dirhams with images on them."

Then Imam (as) said: "People have no choice but to safeguard their belongings, so if he prays while having them, let them be behind him, and he should not place anything between himself and the qibla”.
